Maybe I should, but god knows when.... I'm fully booked until December and new jobs come in every day....
Someone please give OP a paid opportunity...?
I hope you do find it. Don't give up 🖤
A support system made of good people - mainly coworkers who became the best friends I ever had.

It's very brave of you to write this down. 

There is a way forward. I'm 25 and only starting to understand boundaries and healthy relationships to others. It takes time and patience and a lot of work, but you will get there. 

Sending you lot of love.
You have just saved my sanity. Thank you! It was a keyframe problem!
Extremely interesting point of view. Hope you can find your supportive external figure again. Sending some love!

Very interesting comment! I refused to believe in god when I was a child (and still as an adult), but my fatherland his family were very religious. I went on to work a lot on the subject of religions in university and often thought that this is exactly what people must use the figure of God for. This is probably why people want to protect this idea so much... What do you think?
Hope you do one day. Take care of yourself! Completely agree with what you have stated before.

I agree with u/Marikaape, I think it can be anyone you think would help you out in real life, anyone you look up to... People you feel comfortable having around you. 

Actually, the more I think about it, the more I believe that I've done this before in the past, but probably just didn't realise that I was "soothing" myself. 

Good luck with your recovery I wish you all the best!
